exposure: Time from ACS administration to delivery (<24 hours, 24-47 hours, 48-71 hours, ≥72 hours)
Time interval between ACS administration and delivery
Gestational age at delivery (23-28 weeks vs. 29-34 weeks)
cohort: Infants born between 23 0/7 weeks and 33 6/7 weeks gestational age from January 1, 2009 to August 31, 2013
finding: While improvements in neonatal outcomes were observed after any amount of ACS exposure, the most significant improvements were generally seen in infants delivered 24 to 47 hours after administration and between 29 to 34 weeks gestation.
followup_time: Not mentioned, but data collected on length of hospitalization
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but infant birth weight was recorded
